item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00204","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C18","C15","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"No candidate contains the concrete five-part machinery of the child: barring unauthorized entry into a defined sea area, requiring vessels to obey Defense instructions and supervision, assigning enforcement with local law-enforcement cooperation, authorizing implementing regulations, and invoking the penalties under 18 U.S.C. § 2152. C18 is the closest because it expressly refers to defensive sea areas established under § 2152, but it uses that concept only to define protected installations for restrictions on disseminating images. C15 concerns defensive sea areas but merely lists areas being discontinued. C20 has national-defense controls, agency designation, and rulemaking authority, but those are generic administrative similarities applied to radio stations rather than parallel sea-area machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Any person violating any of the provisions of this order shall be subject to the penalties provided by section 2152 of Title 18 of the United States Code.","parent_excerpt":"any defensive sea area hereafter established under authority of section 2152 of title 18 of the United States Code","explanation":"C18 shares the specific statutory reference and the concept of a defensive sea area, but it does not reproduce the child's operative access-control, navigation, enforcement, or penalty structure."},{"child_excerpt":"Whittier Defensive Sea Area","parent_excerpt":"Rose Island Naval Defensive Sea Area ... Tutuila Island Naval Defensive Sea Area","explanation":"C15 concerns the same type of designated area, but its supplied text only enumerates areas being discontinued and offers no reusable operative template."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Defense, or such officer as he may designate, is hereby authorized to prescribe such regulations as he may consider necessary","parent_excerpt":"reference to the Secretary of Defense shall be deemed to include the Secretary or such person as he may designate","explanation":"C20 contains similar designation and implementing-authority language, but these are routine clauses and are not accompanied by substantially parallel machinery."}]}
